from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartMonth(BaseModel):
    """One month's housing starts growth data as reported in a specific release."""
    period: str = Field(description="The month the data refers to (YYYY-MM)")
    single_family_growth: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-month growth rate (%) for single-family starts")
    multi_family_growth: float | None = Field(description="Month-over-month growth rate (%) for buildings with five or more units")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The date this report was published (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve conflicts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_months: list[HousingStartMonth]
